title: He Blessed Me With Forgiveness
summary: Forgiveness is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
lifeApplication: Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.lifeApplication: Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.

evidence.turn: Forgiveness is not the end of the path; it is what makes peace inhabitable.
